name: movscript
description: MovScript project domain editing, source workspace build/review, media query, and generation tools backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, domain objects, source workspace review/build, media queries, and generation.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/domain/generation guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. The MCP bridge exposes system tools for focus, project creation, resources, external media, model discovery, image/video generation, and job polling, plus domain tools for object query/read/upsert/update, candidate management, review, and build.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's system_* tools for current focus, resource-library lookup, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, and image/video generation. Use domain_* tools for MovScript project domain objects: query/read/upsert/update source entities, manage candidates, review changes, and build. Treat generation input_resource_ids/reference_resource_ids as MovScript RawResource IDs only. For domain changes, prefer structured domain APIs; when an API does not cover the requested field or structure, call domain_get_model and edit source files under project.json, project_standards.json, settings/**, scripts/**, content_units/**, or productions/**. Always run domain_review and domain_build after source changes so users can see the effective state in .build/current.
